column1: # note: slice = every directory named 1994-c* or 1994-d* (52 demos). Read blocks-by-ip.txt only; no .asm files opened.
# note: where a demo's window is dominated by a runtime LZ self-unpacker (PKLITE/LZEXE-like), its cycle is reported as
# note:   THREE loops by idiom role -- GETBITS (sh5 acc,1 / dec_r16_jz refill / sh2_r16 rcl-code), COPY_BACK
# note:   (lodsb len; mov_rr16/sub_rr16 distance; rep_movsb) and the literal MEMCOPY (movsb / stosb) -- rather than one
# note:   90%-share line, because the study is about the vocabulary of idioms, not about which program is packed.
# note: NEW_SOFTFP_MUL / NEW_SOFTFP_NORM are the only new tags. They name ONE library (byte-identical blocks in
# note:   cyclewar/CYCLE 70e0, deadtro e3a0, diesel/DIESEL 483f0, dragon 3f650 -- the Borland/TP emulated-FPU pack):
# note:   MUL = multiword mantissa multiply, mul_m16 x6 with add/adc/adc carry chains, no shift; NORM = shift/subtract

# note: "unknown register" convention: r0,r1,.. are renamed by first appearance inside the loop, never a real x86 name.
